query: UPDATE public.persons SET display_name = COALESCE($3, display_name), phone_enc = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE phone_enc END, phone_bidx = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $6 ELSE phone_bidx END, locale = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE locale END, updated_at = $9, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $10 AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING version
